entries.title: Psalms 63:1
segments: A Psalm of David, when he was in the wilderness of Judah. O God, You [are] my God; I will seek You earnestly; my soul thirsts for You; my flesh longs for You, as in a dry and thirsty land, where no water is;

entries.title: Psalms 63:2
segments: so I have seen You in the holy place, seeing Your power and Your glory.

entries.title: Psalms 63:3
segments: Because Your loving-kindness [is] better than life, my lips shall praise You.

entries.title: Psalms 63:4
segments: So I will bless You while I live; I will lift up my hands in Your name.

entries.title: Psalms 63:5
segments: My soul shall be satisfied as [with] marrow and fatness; and my mouth shall praise [You] with joyful lips,

entries.title: Psalms 63:6
segments: when I remember You on my bed and think of You in the night watches.

entries.title: Psalms 63:7
segments: Because You have been my help, therefore in the shadow of Your wings I will rejoice.

entries.title: Psalms 63:8
segments: My soul follows hard after You; Your right hand upholds me.

entries.title: Psalms 63:9
segments: But those [who] seek my soul, to destroy it, shall go into the depths of the earth.

entries.title: Psalms 63:10
segments: They shall fall by the sword; they shall be a serving for jackals.

entries.title: Psalms 63:11
segments: But the king shall rejoice in God; everyone who swears by Him shall glory; but the mouth of those who speak lies shall be stopped.
